_comment: Copy to ~/.pickik/config.json (or pass --config). READ BY pick_ik_mcp/mcp_server.py, which is the CLIENT of the bridge. The bridge inside Blender takes its own knobs from the add-on preferences (Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > PickIK arm7), not from this file: what crosses the process boundary is only host, port and token, and it crosses via runtime_file. See pick_ik_mcp/README.md, 'who reads what'.
